'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Pope Francis]] accepts the resignations of [[Ecuador|Ecuadorian]] Bishop Julio Parrilla Díaz and Monsignor Gerardo Miguel Nieves Loja of the [[Roman Catholic Diocese of Riobamba|Diocese of Riobamba]] after reports of poor governance, financial mismanagement and moral failings. [https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2021-04-28/pope-ousts-leadership-of-ecuadorian-diocese-amid-complaints (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Riga hostel fire]]
**Eight people are killed and nine others wounded in a fire at an illegal hostel in [[Riga]], [[Latvia]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-56898717 (BBC News)]
*A 6.4 magnitude [[earthquake]] hits the [[India]]n [[states and union territories of India|states]] of [[West Bengal]] and [[Assam]], part of [[Meghalaya]], and part of [[Bangladesh]], causing damage to houses and buildings. Two people die from [[heart attack]]s, while ten others are wounded by the earthquake itself. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/other-states/earthquake-of-magnitude-64-strikes-assam/article34427787.ece (''The Hindu'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Cambodia]]
****[[Cambodia]] reports a record 698 new cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide number of cases to 11,761. [https://www.khmertimeskh.com/50847647/a-record-high-698-cases-994-recoveries-and-six-deaths-all-in-one-day/ (''Khmer Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in India]]
*****[[India]] begins a [[COVID-19 vaccine]] registration for those over the age of 18. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/covid-19-vaccine-registration-for-those-above-18-to-begin-at-4-pm-on-april-28/article34428071.ece (''The Hindu'')]
****[[India]] surpasses 200,000 deaths from COVID-19 after a record 3,293 [[COVID-19 pandemic deaths|deaths]] are reported in the past 24 hours, subsequently becoming the fourth country to do so. The country also reports a new global record of 360,960 new cases, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 17.9 million. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/india-passes-200-000-covid-19-deaths-new-cases-spike-n1265598 (NBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Pakistan]]
****[[Pakistan]] reports a record 201 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 17,530. [https://tribune.com.pk/story/2297172/pakistan-records-highest-covid-19-death-toll-since-start-of-pandemic (''Tribune'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****[[COVID-19 community quarantines in the Philippines]]
*****[[President of the Philippines|President]] [[Rodrigo Duterte]] approves the extension of the Modified Enhanced Community Quarantine in the [[Greater Manila Area]] until May 14. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/news/04/28/21/may-2021-quarantine-ncr-plus-mecq (ABS-CBN News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Albania]]
****[[Albania]] surpasses 10,000 seniors who have received their second dose of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://tvklan.al/rinis-vaksinimi-masiv-marrin-dozen-e-dyte-10-mije-te-moshuar/ (TV Klan)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Poland]]
****[[Poland|Polish]] [[Prime Minister of Poland|Prime Minister]] [[Mateusz Morawiecki]] announces an easing of the country's [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] restrictions after a decrease in the number of new cases, which will allow shopping malls and museums to reopen on May 4, hotels to reopen on May 8, and restaurants and cafés to serve people on outdoor terraces beginning on May 15. [https://www.thefirstnews.com/article/getting-back-to-normal-bars-cafes-and-restaurants-to-reopen-and-no-more-facemasks-in-the-streets-as-govt-says-lockdown-restrictions-to-be-lifted-21577 (''The First News'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]]
****[[Turkey]] signs an agreement to purchase 50 million doses of the [[Russia]]n [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine|Sputnik V]] [[vaccine]]. [https://www.dailysabah.com/turkey/turkey-to-buy-50-million-doses-of-russias-sputnik-v-vaccine/news (''Daily Sabah'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Tunisia]]
****[[Tunisia]]n authorities announce that they will impose a mandatory [[quarantine]] on all travelers for a week beginning on May 3 and continue to suspend schools until May 16 in an effort to slow the spread of COVID-19. [https://english.alarabiya.net/coronavirus/2021/04/28/Tunisia-imposes-mandatory-COVID-19-quarantine-on-visitors-extends-closure-of-schools (Al-Arabiya)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Africa]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in South Africa]]
*****[[South Africa]] resumes its use of the [[Johnson & Johnson COVID-19 vaccine|Johnson & Johnson]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] to [[healthcare worker]]s after a pause of more than two weeks, following the [[South African Health Products Regulatory Authority|drug authority]] decision that the vaccine is safe. [https://apnews.com/article/us-food-and-drug-administration-africa-south-africa-health-coronavirus-3dc66ad1365076fa6b489bb6d50f8eea (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2019 Trump–Ukraine scandal]]
**Federal investigators raid the home of [[Rudy Giuliani]], the former personal lawyer of former [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]], for suspected illegal lobbying of the [[federal government of the United States|federal government]] on behalf of Ukrainian officials. [https://www.nytimes.com/2021/04/28/nyregion/rudy-giuliani-trump-ukraine-warrant.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Mass shootings in the United States]]
**A gunman kills two of his family members and two responding sheriff's deputies during a 13-hour standoff in [[Boone, North Carolina]]. The perpetrator later commits suicide at the scene. [https://apnews.com/article/north-carolina-shootings-d74f91e7fcffa316212d9c42e70e19ec (AP)]
*[[LNU Lightning Complex fires]]
**A man from [[Vallejo, California]], is arrested and charged for intentionally setting the Markley Fire, which killed two people and eventually merged with the Hennessey Fire as part of the LNU Lightning Complex, one of the largest wildfires in California's history. Authorities say the suspect set the fire in order to cover up the murder of a woman found near [[Lake Berryessa]], which he had already been arrested and charged for in September 2020. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/california-wildfire-killed-2-was-started-cover-murder-officials-say-n1265805 (NBC News)]
*[[Gretchen Whitmer kidnapping plot]]
**Federal prosecutors lay out additional charges for three men suspected of plotting to kidnap Michigan Governor [[Gretchen Whitmer]]. The new charges, which include conspiracy to use a weapon of mass destruction, relate to an alleged related plot by the men to detonate explosives at a bridge in order to slow down responding law enforcement. [https://www.cnn.com/2021/04/28/politics/gretchen-whitmer-kidnap-plot-charges/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.freep.com/story/news/local/michigan/2021/04/28/whitmer-kidnap-charges-weapons-mass-destruction/4874420001/ (''Detroit Free-Press'')]
*Four people are killed and another is wounded during a [[mass stabbing]] at a hospital in [[Potsdam]], [[Brandenburg]], [[Germany]]. The perpetrator, identified as a female hospital's employee, is arrested. The victims are all patients. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/four-killed-german-hospital-woman-arrested-media-2021-04-28/ (Reuters)]
*Two children are killed and 16 more are wounded during a [[mass stabbing]] attack at a kindergarten in [[Beiliu]], [[Guangxi]], [[China]]. The attacker has been arrested. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-56923427 (BBC News)]
*Five former members of the Italian [[far-left]] group [[Red Brigades]], the co-founder of [[Lotta Continua]], and another far-left militant are arrested in [[Paris]], [[France]]. [https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2021/04/28/terrorismo-arrestati-a-parigi-i-7-brigatisti_710152e0-08a9-4192-8a3d-1f10a662cb7f.html (''Ansa'')]
*The [[Correos|Spanish postal service]] intercepts a letter with bullets enclosed that was mailed to former [[Prime Minister of Spain|Prime Minister]] [[José Luis Rodríguez Zapatero]]. [https://www.elperiodico.com/es/politica/20210428/correos-carta-amenaza-balas-zapatero-11687423 (''El Periódico'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Northern Ireland riots]]
**[[Northern Ireland]] [[First Minister and deputy First Minister of Northern Ireland|First Minister]] [[Arlene Foster]] announces her resignation after losing the support of her [[Democratic Unionist Party]] in the aftermath of the [[riot]]s. [https://www.urdupoint.com/en/world/nireland-first-minister-foster-announces-res-1237280.html (UrduPoint)]
